title: Robot reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- robot body -->
  <rect x="30" y="45" width="40" height="35" rx="8" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x="34" y="48" width="12" height="28" rx="4" fill="#a8e0f0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x="32" y="15" width="36" height="30" rx="8" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- face screen -->
  <rect x="36" y="20" width="28" height="20" rx="4" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="28" r="3" fill="#6ef0a8"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="28" r="3" fill="#6ef0a8"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 34 Q50 38 56 34" stroke="#6ef0a8" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1="50" y1="15" x2="50" y2="8" stroke="#7ec8e3" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="7" r="3" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <!-- arms holding book -->
  <rect x="18" y="58" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <rect x="68" y="58" width="14" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x="30" y="62" width="40" height="20" rx="2" fill="#e85d5d"/>
  <!-- book spine -->
  <rect x="48" y="62" width="4" height="20" fill="#c44"/>
  <!-- book pages left -->
  <rect x="32" y="64" width="15" height="16" rx="1" fill="#fff8e7"/>
  <!-- book pages right -->
  <rect x="53" y="64" width="15" height="16" rx="1" fill="#fff8e7"/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1="35" y1="68" x2="45" y2="68" stroke="#d4c4a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="72" x2="45" y2="72" stroke="#d4c4a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="76" x2="43" y2="76" stroke="#d4c4a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="68" x2="65" y2="68" stroke="#d4c4a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="72" x2="65" y2="72" stroke="#d4c4a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="76" x2="63" y2="76" stroke="#d4c4a8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="80" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <rect x="54" y="80" width="10" height="10" rx="3" fill="#5bb8d4"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x="33" y="88" width="16" height="6" rx="3" fill="#3a9ab5"/>
  <rect x="51" y="88" width="16" height="6" rx="3" fill="#3a9ab5"/>
  <!-- heart on chest -->
  <path d="M50 55 Q50 52 47 52 Q44 52 44 55 Q44 58 50 62 Q56 58 56 55 Q56 52 53 52 Q50 52 50 55Z" fill="#ffd93d"/>
</svg>
